name: Taufa'ahau Tupou IV
exact_submitted_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: fixed 2D cartoon character portrait for the Spheres historical strategy game, portrait aspect ratio 2:3, 1024 x 1536.
Primary request: Transform the identity in reference image 2 into one finished full-body cartoon of Taufa'ahau Tupou IV, the Tongan man who was King of Tonga in 1990. This is the exact person taufaahau_tupou_iv, not his mother Salote Tupou III, his son George Tupou V, or Tupou VI.
Input images: Image 1 (Margaret Thatcher cartoon) supplies ONLY the established game's linework, simplified cel shading, figure framing and opaque teal background. Do not copy that woman's identity, clothing, hairstyle or bag. Image 2 (Comet Photo / ETH Library, portrait dated 1985) is the identity/likeness and upper-body clothing reference. Preserve this man's recognizable facial structure and heavy build, not the photograph's seated pose, setting or photographic texture.
Subject and era: Respectful near-1990 artistic appearance of a Tongan man about 71 years old, based on the observed 1985 portrait with only restrained age treatment. Broad rounded face and cheeks, very broad nose, full lower lip, heavy-lidded brown eyes, high receding forehead, short swept-back silver-gray hair with wavy texture, clean shaven, medium warm brown complexion and very broad stocky body. Calm, dignified, slight reserved smile. No glasses.
Clothing: The observed brown civilian suit, ivory shirt and dark brown diagonally light-striped tie; continue the suit into simple matching trousers and polished dark shoes. Standing full-body extension is an illustration, not a claimed documentary view. Hands relaxed and visible at his sides. No crown, medals, sash, badges, scepter, uniform or invented regalia.
Style/medium: Clearly drawn 2D cartoon, strong clean dark outlines, graphic cel shading and simplified expressive facial shapes, a slightly enlarged head with about 5 to 5.5-head adult proportions. Match reference 1's visual language while retaining his naturally very broad physique. This is not a photorealistic portrait, 3D render, toy, caricature mockery or painterly photograph.
Composition: Exactly one man centered, standing in a mild three-quarter pose facing the viewer, complete head, both hands and both shoes fully inside the canvas with comfortable margin. Readable silhouette at small avatar size. Quiet intentionally opaque dark teal backdrop matching reference 1, very subtle ground contact shadow, no scene or furniture.
Constraints: Preserve reference 2 identity; all facial features should read together as this specific person. No other people, writing, title, border, watermark, royal emblem, photographic grain, checkerboard, weapon or handbag. Do not insert attribution text into the art; attribution is retained separately in the game metadata.
persistence: Byte-identical copy of built-in output; no pixel edits or recompression.
